detail_text: Specifically, your firm lacks a specific training and verification schedule to evaluate the skills and expertise needed for personnel engaged in the visual inspection of finished drug products. Currently, according to SOP #4125, entitled "Visual Inspection -Finished Product," Version 1.1, effective date 3/22/18, an eye exam is to be completed [redacted] for personnel responsible for the inspection of finished drug products. Yet, your firm does not have any written procedures that establish a requirement for personnel performing visual inspection to complete an eye exam, which tests for color-blindness and/or the ability to distinguish color. Moreover, eye exam testing for color-blindness and/or the ability to distinguish color are not collected or documented for personnel engaged in visual inspection.

detail_text: Management stated the switching rules were not for the remediated lots. Section 9.3.1 of ISO 2859-1 requires the sampling to go to tightened inspection when REDACTED [redacted] out of REDACTED [redacted] consecutive lots have been non-accepted. The results from AQL sampling of the remediated lots found the first two lots of ATNAA (2M1257 and 2M1513) met the criteria of zero low atropine fills, yet the next 8 batches failed. The REDACTED [redacted] lot should have been under tightened inspection if the switching rules in IS0-2859-1 were followed. ISO 2859-1 Section 12.6.1 "Use of individual plans" reads "Occasionally, specific individual plans are selected from this part of ISO 2859 and used without the switching rules. For example, a purchaser may be using the plan s for verification purposes only. This is not the intended application of the system given in this part of ISO 2859 and its use in this way shall not be referred to as "inspection in compliance with ISO 2859-1."” The Modified Contract section 2.c signed 9/19/13 states that a sample size of REDACTED [redacted] units from ea ch lot shall be evaluated in accordance with ISO 2859-l and that the sample will meet an Acceptable Quality Level (AQL) of REDACTED [redacted]. Documentation was not provided to support that AQL samples were collected at random. The modified contrac t section 2c states in part, "remaining ATNAA units from each lot/batch shall include an additional inspection whereby a sample size of REDACTED [redacted] units in accordance with ISO 2859-1.. ISO 2859-1 states in section 8.1: "The items selected for the sample shall be drawn from the lot by simple random sampling... ". No evidence was provided that AQL samples were drawn at random for ATNAA lots 1M1512, 2M1257, 2M1513, or 1M1738. The batch records and written procedures do not include instructions and documentation on where and how samples were collected. The Process Technology Manager stated there are no specific instructions on bow to collect random samples. The Modified Contract signed 9/19/13 states "Remaining ATNAA units from each lot/batch shall include an additional inspection whereby a sample size of REDACTED [redacted] units in accordance with ISO 2859-1 [is evaluated]".
detail_text_ko: 경영진은 전환 규칙(switching rules)이 개선된 로트에는 적용되지 않았다고 진술했다. ISO 2859-1 의 Section 9.3.1 은 연속 REDACTED [redacted] 로트 중 REDACTED [redacted] 로트가 불합격되면 시료 채취를 강화 검사로 전환하도록 요구한다. 개선된 로트의 AQL 시료 채취 결과 ATNAA 의 처음 두 로트(2M1257 및 2M1513)는 atropine 저충전 0건 기준을 충족했으나 다음 8개 배치는 불합격이었다. IS0-2859-1 의 전환 규칙을 따랐다면 REDACTED [redacted] 로트는 강화 검사 대상이었어야 한다. ISO 2859-1 Section 12.6.1 "Use of individual plans" 는 다음과 같이 적고 있다 "Occasionally, specific individual plans are selected from this part of ISO 2859 and used without the switching rules. For example, a purchaser may be using the plan s for verification purposes only. This is not the intended application of the system given in this part of ISO 2859 and its use in this way shall not be referred to as "inspection in compliance with ISO 2859-1."” 9/19/13 에 서명된 Modified Contract 의 section 2.c 는 각 로트에서 REDACTED [redacted] 단위의 시료 크기를 ISO 2859-l 에 따라 평가해야 하며 시료가 REDACTED [redacted] 의 허용 품질 수준(AQL)을 충족해야 한다고 규정한다. AQL 시료가 무작위로 채취되었음을 뒷받침하는 문서는 제공되지 않았다. 수정 계약 section 2c 는 일부에서 "remaining ATNAA units from each lot/batch shall include an additional inspection whereby a sample size of REDACTED [redacted] units in accordance with ISO 2859-1.." 이라고 규정한다. ISO 2859-1 은 section 8.1 에서 다음과 같이 규정한다: "The items selected for the sample shall be drawn from the lot by simple random sampling... ". ATNAA 로트 1M1512, 2M1257, 2M1513, 1M1738 에 대해 AQL 시료가 무작위로 채취되었다는 증거는 제공되지 않았다. 배치 기록서와 서면 절차에는 시료를 어디에서 어떻게 채취했는지에 대한 지침과 문서화가 포함되어 있지 않다. 공정 기술 관리자는 무작위 시료를 채취하는 방법에 대한 구체적인 지침이 없다고 진술했다. 9/19/13 에 서명된 Modified Contract 는 "Remaining ATNAA units from each lot/batch shall include an additional inspection whereby a sample size of REDACTED [redacted] units in accordance with ISO 2859-1 [is evaluated]" 라고 규정한다.
